_: Legend buffs (Ed, 2026-10-04): while a party legend lives (a creature in your party that has evolved into a legend), it gives every witch its species' buff. Each species has one: kind (what it changes) and value. Kinds: flightSpeed (her flying speed, times value), spellCooldown (the spell's recharge time, times value: below 1 is quicker), spellDuration (how long the spell lasts, times value), leashLength (how far party animals roam from their leash point, times value), leashRun (how fast party animals hurry back to their leash point, times value), berrySeek (how far party animals look for berries, times value), evolveFaster (berries needed to evolve, times value: below 1 is fewer), talkTime (seconds of talk to invite a creature, times value: below 1 is quicker), partyPace (party animals following you move faster, times value), waveCountdown (seconds between waves, times value: above 1 is more time), glowReach (how far glow and light reach round you, times value), forecastAhead (the forecast shows value more waves ahead; a hook until the forecast exists). Two legends of the same kind multiply (forecastAhead adds), then the total is held inside limits [min, max]. label: the line shown when the buff is gained and in the buff row's tooltip.
